metadata.title: Graphics & performance — Nebula
metadata.description: Frame rate, resolution, upscaling and detail settings.

page.paragraph_2: Frame rate, resolution, upscaling and detail settings.

ray-tracing.paragraph_1: Ray-traced lighting is being worked on and will come in a very soon release. It is not in Nebula v2 yet.
ray-tracing.paragraph_2: When it arrives, it will need a GPU with hardware ray tracing.
ray-tracing.paragraph_3: Until then, the GRAPHICS page has enhanced lighting, ambient occlusion and HDR.

smoothness.paragraph_1: The game runs at 60 updates per second. Interpolation draws frames between updates for faster displays.
smoothness.paragraph_2: On the GRAPHICS page, set Interpolation to Native and choose a target frame rate or Match refresh. Higher rates use more GPU time.
smoothness.paragraph_3: DLSS Frame Generation works with DLSS on NVIDIA RTX 40 and 50 series GPUs. FSR frame generation works with FSR 3, XeSS or SGSR 2 on displays of 119 Hz or more.

resolution.cell_1_1: Resolution of the 3D scene, from 144p to 2160p, or Match display.
resolution.cell_1_2: Lower this first if the game runs slowly.
resolution.cell_2_1: Auto, or a fixed ratio from 4:3 to 32:9.
resolution.cell_3_1: Resolution of text, menus and the HUD.
resolution.cell_4_1: DLSS, FSR 3, XeSS, SGSR 2 and MetalFX render fewer pixels and rebuild the image. FSR 1 scales the finished image.
resolution.cell_4_2: Start with Quality; try Balanced for more speed.
resolution.cell_5_2: MSAA costs the most GPU time.
resolution.cell_6_2: Keep on unless you prefer the original outlines.
resolution.cell_7_2: Raise it for clearer floors and walls.
resolution.cell_8_1: SSAO or GTAO shading where surfaces meet.
resolution.cell_8_2: Turn it off to reduce GPU load.
resolution.cell_10_1: Per vertex (original), per pixel, or enhanced.
resolution.cell_11_1: Wide brightness range on an HDR display.
resolution.cell_11_2: Shown when the display is in HDR mode.

performance.item_1: Lower the internal resolution before the display resolution.
performance.item_2: Use DLSS, FSR 3 or XeSS in Quality or Balanced mode. DLSS needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU and a one-time download.
performance.item_4: The Performance preset on the GRAPHICS page lowers resolution and turns off optional effects.
performance.item_5: Choose a lower interpolation target, such as 120 instead of 240.
performance.item_6: Turn off ambient occlusion or lower MSAA.
performance.item_7: On a laptop, connect power. Nebula uses the high-performance GPU by default.
performance.paragraph_1: Benchmark on the home screen recommends settings for your computer.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
